mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_quote_sheet_detail (id, quote_sheet_id, product_id, product_snapshot, sale_price, inquiry_product, tenant_id) VALUES (#{item.id}, #{item.quoteSheetId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productSnapshot}, #{item.salePrice}, #{item.inquiryProduct}, #{item.tenantId})
mapper.select:
SELECT q.id AS quote_sheet_id, q.name AS quote_sheet_name, q.start_date, q.end_date, q.status, d.id AS detail_id, d.product_id, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name, p.spec, u.name AS unit, d.sale_price, d.inquiry_product FROM tbl_quote_sheet_detail d INNER JOIN tbl_quote_sheet q ON q.id = d.quote_sheet_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product p ON p.id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_unit u ON u.id = p.unit
AND q.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.quoteSheetName}, '%') AND q.status = #{vo.status} AND q.start_date >= #{vo.startDate} AND q.end_date <= #{vo.endDate} AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.productKeyword}, '%') OR p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.productKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY q.create_time DESC, d.create_time ASC
